# volcano_oauth_providers (Data Source)

OAuth provider types a project can configure via volcano_oauth_config, with their default scopes. This lists what's available, not what's currently configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_oauth_providers" "available" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`
